item.title: A Repeatable Microsoft 365 Offboarding Script with Graph PowerShell
item.description:
Overview

Offboarding is one of those tasks that’s simple on paper and easy to get subtly wrong in practice. Miss a step and you end up with a departed user who still has an active session token, a mailbox nobody can read, or a license you’re paying for months later.

Between employees and a steady rotation of contractors, I was offboarding people often enough that a checklist in my head wasn’t good enough. This post walks through the script I use now. It takes a UPN and runs the whole sequence the same way every time.

item.title: Configuring SAML and MFA on Cisco Firepower 1120
item.description:
Overview

Setting up SAML authentication with MFA on a Cisco Firepower 1120 for VPN access is essential for modern security requirements. Microsoft’s documentation provides a good starting point, but it’s missing critical CLI configuration commands for the Firepower side.

This guide fills in those gaps and documents the lessons learned during implementation.

Prerequisites

  • Cisco Firepower 1120 with appropriate licensing and AnyConnect
  • Microsoft Entra ID tenant with administrative access
  • Access to Firepower via ASDM or CLI
  • Your Firepower VPN’s public FQDN and SSL certificate configured
